name: 42535-dataurlimage-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, ~8.3B: a 32-block vision tower (patch 14, 2x2 spatial merge) in front of a 28-layer decoder (hidden 3584, 28 query heads, 4 KV heads, 128k window). Full shapes on the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, bounded at 512 requests with a 1800 s safety cap; warmup the first 20% and cooldown the last 10%; static seed 42535. About 410 requests reach the aggregate, not 512x0.7: the warmup resolves against the request bound (102 requests, less those already in flight), while the cooldown resolves to 180 s reckoned against the 1800 s safety cap, which a one-stream run ends long before, so nothing is discarded at the end.
workload: Single-turn image chat, synthesised by guidellm from two --data sources because synthetic_image emits only an image column and the prompt text needs a text source beside it. (1) synthetic_text: 32 prompt tokens and 8 output tokens, each pinned min==max; the backend turns the output side into max_tokens=8 plus ignore_eos, so length cannot drift. output_tokens SUMS across sources and is therefore declared on this source only. (2) synthetic_image: 1920x1080, format jpeg, jpeg_quality 95, content noise, images_per_request 1. Every row's image is distinct -- synthetic_image derives each row's seed from the row index and can never repeat one. Under the declared `max_pixels: 200704` each upload is downscaled to 1024 patches, i.e. 256 vision tokens, so a request is about 290 prompt tokens with the chat template.
purpose: A single-user visual question answering service captioning one high-resolution photo per request with brief replies on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Everything not listed is left at the engine's defaults.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# A request is ~290 prompt + 8 generated tokens. 8192 clears that with room to spare, keeps a
# prompt from ever being split across scheduler steps, and keeps the checkpoint's own 128k window
# from reserving KV this item never touches.
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# The vision budget: 200704 / (14 x 14) = 1024 patches, which the 2x2 spatial merge reduces to
# exactly 256 vision tokens, whatever the uploader sends.
# INLINE JSON, not an indented block: the config reader is line-based and skips indented lines, so
# a block-form dict silently never reaches the engine, which then starts with no budget at rc=0.
mm-processor-kwargs: {"max_pixels": 200704}

# On by default at this commit, so this line does work. Every synthesised image and prompt is
# distinct, so there is nothing to reuse, and turning it off keeps a warming cache out of the
# steady state.
enable-prefix-caching: false
